# mimecast_address_alteration_policies (Data Source)

Read all Address Alteration policies through the documented omitted-ID legacy read contract.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_address_alteration_policies" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `id` (String) Stable Address Alteration policy inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
